_comment: Smol-only synchronous FP32 CUDA versus Transformers; pinned official HF source and llama.cpp converter; refuse noncanonical GGUF before any forward; retain scientific HALTED outcomes.

jobs.name: hf_cuda_smol
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz converter.tgz smol_manifest.json COMMITS hf_cuda_vm.sh INPUT_SHA256SUMS; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/hf_cuda_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
